نحتبي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَبِي (naḥtabī) /naħ.ta.biː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
# نَحْتَبِيَ (naḥtabiya) /naħ.ta.bi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَبَى (iḥtabā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
